meta.name: glycoengineering
meta.description: Analyze and engineer protein glycosylation. Scan sequences for N-glycosylation sequons (N-X-S/T), predict O-glycosylation hotspots, and access curated glycoengineering tools (NetOGlyc, GlycoShield, GlycoWorkbench). For glycoprotein engineering, therapeutic antibody optimization, and vaccine design.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析蛋白质糖基化位点,辅助抗体与疫苗设计
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在做治疗性抗体或疫苗的糖基化设计。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze protein glycosylation sites to support antibody and vaccine design.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you engineer glycosylation for therapeutic antibodies or vaccines.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会分析蛋白质序列中的糖基化位点:识别 N-糖基化基序(N-X-S/T)、预测 O-糖基化热点,并可调用 NetOGlyc、GlycoShield、GlycoWorkbench 等外部工具辅助糖基化工程。
howto.when: 当用户给出蛋白质序列并要求分析糖基化位点,或涉及抗体工程、治疗性蛋白设计、疫苗抗原设计等糖基化相关问题时触发。

say.text: 分析这条蛋白序列的N-糖基化位点
say.note: 会扫描N-X-S/T基序并列出位置、基序和上下文

say.text: 把IgG1 Fc的N297位点突变为Q以去除糖基化
预测这条序列的O-糖基化热点
say.note: 会根据S/T密度给出候选位点

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can analyze protein sequences for glycosylation sites: identify N-glycosylation sequons (N-X-S/T), predict O-glycosylation hotspots, and access external tools such as NetOGlyc, GlycoShield, and GlycoWorkbench to assist glycoengineering.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user provides a protein sequence and asks for glycosylation analysis, or when questions involve antibody engineering, therapeutic protein design, vaccine antigen design, etc.

say_en.text: Analyze the N-glycosylation sites in this protein sequence.
say_en.note: Scans for N-X-S/T motifs and lists positions, motifs, and context.

say_en.text: Mutate N297 to Q in the IgG1 Fc to remove glycosylation.
Predict O-glycosylation hotspots in this sequence.
say_en.note: Returns candidate sites based on S/T density.
